text:
cara-docs: FYI opened a PR that clarifies model card support for embedding sharding and updates the limits table for Nebula3b; needs quick review before tomorrow's docs deploy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

matt-eng-ml: Looking. Quick summary of changes?

cara-docs: Added section 'Embedding sharding' explaining that models with >2B params support sharding across 2 GPUs; adjusted max_batch for nebula3b from 128 to 64 for 16GB nodes; removed ambiguous 'unlimited' wording from the sequence limits row.

sam-platform: Are those numbers validated on Dedicated? I saw better batching on our 40GB rig.

matt-eng-ml: Benchmarks: nebula3b on 16GB nodes: 512 tokens x64 batch => ~82 qps; 40GB can do x128 => ~160 qps. I'll paste the minimal bench command.

matt-eng-ml: ```bash
# quick perf run we used
./bench --model nebula3b --seq 512 --batch 64 --gpu mem=16GB
```

cara-docs: Nice — can you add those qps numbers to the note? Keep it high-level (approx).

jen-qa: Also add a regen test in docs-evals for the example prompts — one assert on output length + a flaky-tolerance check so CI doesn't fail on tiny variance.

kevin-sdk: Heads up: SDK snippet in the card still uses deprecated arg `truncate=True`; new SDK uses `max_tokens` for embedding truncation.

kevin-sdk: Proposed snippet update:
```python
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='nebula3b', input=my_text, max_tokens=512)
```

cara-docs: thanks @kevin-sdk — pushed that change and updated the example to mention `model_version='v2'` for clarity. Also fixed two dead cross-links in the card.

docbot: CI build passed (docs lint, linkcheck) — https://ci.redwood/1234 :white_check_mark:

sam-platform: Quick Q — do we need to add a compatibility note for int8 quantized variants re: KV cache cross-GPU?

matt-eng-ml: Yes, add: 'int8 quantized variants currently do NOT support cross-GPU KV cache; run on single GPU or use Aurora-quantized variants that were tested for sharding.'

cara-docs: Done. @jen-qa assigning you for final content sign-off; @matt-eng-ml for bench numbers verification; @kevin-sdk for SDK snippet approval.

jen-qa: Will review this afternoon. If no issues, merge after sign-offs. :thumbsup:

matt-eng-ml: Verified numbers, LGTM.

kevin-sdk: Approving SDK snippet. Minor nit: include explicit version param `model_version='v2'` in the example to avoid ambiguity.

cara-docs: updated and squashed commits. Targeting merge at 11:30 PT.

sam-platform: Thanks — I'll watch the runtime rollout and flag any perf deltas.

cara-docs: Merged. Thanks team! :tada:
